# Code Libraries & Services

The recommended open-source building blocks and hosted services for the stack.

<a id="nextjs"></a>
### Next.js (App Router)

`https://nextjs.org/docs` · library · **core** · phases: Build

React framework with first-class Vercel hosting.

**Use when**
- The production app

**Avoid when**
- A one-file prototype

**How to use**
- Use the App Router and Server Actions for simple CRUD

**Docs:** https://nextjs.org/docs

---

<a id="shadcn-ui"></a>
### shadcn/ui

`https://ui.shadcn.com` · library · **core** · phases: Build

Copy-in, accessible React components (Radix-based) you own and can restyle.

**Use when**
- Buttons, dialogs, sheets (slide-overs), tables, forms, command palette

**How to use**
- Its CSS-variable theming maps 1:1 to tokens.css; see docs/stack/04-tokens-to-tailwind.md

**Docs:** https://ui.shadcn.com

---

<a id="supabase"></a>
### Supabase

`https://supabase.com/docs` · library · **core** · phases: Define, Build

Postgres database, auth and storage with row-level security; generous free tier.

**Use when**
- Storing clients, deals, activities; login

**Avoid when**
- You only need a Google Sheet

**How to use**
- Enable RLS on every table; owner-only policies

**Docs:** https://supabase.com/docs

---

<a id="tailwind"></a>
### Tailwind CSS

`https://tailwindcss.com/docs` · library · **core** · phases: Build

Utility CSS; map design-system tokens to it.

**Use when**
- All styling

**How to use**
- Point theme colors at CSS variables from design-system/tokens.css

**Docs:** https://tailwindcss.com/docs

<a id="dnd-kit"></a>
### dnd-kit

`https://dndkit.com` · library · **recommended** · phases: Build

Accessible drag-and-drop toolkit with keyboard support.

**Use when**
- The pipeline board

**How to use**
- Keep a 'Move to…' menu as the keyboard path too

**Docs:** https://dndkit.com

### Google Fonts / next/font

`https://fonts.google.com` · library · **recommended** · phases: Direction, Build

**How to use**

<a id="lucide"></a>
### Lucide Icons

`https://lucide.dev` · library · **recommended** · phases: Build

Consistent open-source icon set (shadcn default).

**Use when**
- All UI icons

**Avoid when**
- Mixing icon sets

**How to use**
- One stroke width app-wide (1.5 or 2)

**Docs:** https://lucide.dev

<a id="motion-lib"></a>
### Motion (Framer Motion)

`https://motion.dev` · library · **recommended** · phases: Build

Animation library for React with layout animations.

**Use when**
- Board card moves, slide-overs, list reordering

**Avoid when**
- Simple hovers (use CSS)

**How to use**
- Respect the motion rule tokens (100-300ms)

**Docs:** https://motion.dev

### Recharts

Composable React charts; also used by shadcn/ui charts.

- Style with tokens; follow docs/design/04-data-viz.md
